The kernel branches before _outside_task_set and the capability lookup; the registry refuses a plugin capability declaring the id (PR-09). At least one citation, checked by 3e.1's check_citations with the ClassView rule; an unresolved citation is a KERNEL-CITATION repair; a non-admitted call is KERNEL-GROUNDED-ANSWER in on and today's path in off/shadow; a check failure fails closed (no typed verifier to fall back to). No ActionRecord; message.final gains contract_id and at-rest citations; ReasonCode.GROUNDED ends SUCCEEDED, never verified (PR-19): the release report counts it apart, the evidence bundle's grounded section (gated on reason_code) labels free text unverified, and every UI surface (outcome panel, run badge and tone, overview, timeline, task history, reference-vanilla header) shows 'grounded, not verified'. GROUNDED_ANSWER id in contracts/task.py (import cycle). ERP read-only task open-pos (five read capabilities, grounded_answer true); it is a preset for the live driver, and the scripted fixture driver refuses it at runtime build. Commits 51872b0, 7726ad2, 861394d, c5db618, 8002b77, 5a60a42's parent; reviews harness/state/3/reviews/3e.2-r1.json, 3e.2-r2.json.
